resources.string: Tap to allow HideNav in Shizuku
Start Shizuku or Nightzuku, then come back
Fades out when you open an app
Only applies while the pill is hidden
Hold where the pill used to be
Only needed while the pill is hidden
Apps still leave room for the bar

Without root, the system keeps telling apps a 24 dp navigation bar is there. Most apps already draw behind it, so hiding the pill frees the space visually, but an app that pads its own bottom bar will still leave a small gap.
The pill comes back if Shizuku stops
HideNav reapplies your settings whenever Shizuku starts, including after a reboot.
Circle to Search takes a moment longer
With the pill hidden, Launcher ignores long presses, so HideNav replays one for it. Expect about two thirds of a second instead of half.
